verdict.rationale: Natural language is Skyvern's core interface. You give it a plain-language prompt and a URL to run a task (skyvern-docs-18, skyvern-docs-33). The SDK accepts natural-language act/extract/validate commands (skyvern-docs-19). Copilot chat and plain-English SOP upload build agents and workflows without code (skyvern-docs-29, skyvern-docs-25, skyvern-docs-24), and the MCP server lets AI assistants drive the browser (skyvern-docs-7). A hands-on report confirms prompt-driven runs work on the happy path but struggled on a harder site (skyvern-comm-2); missing for 10: independent evidence that natural-language commands execute reliably beyond happy-path sites.
